generated_email.conteudo:
Dear Costumer, 

We have detected issues with your bank account. To avoid freezing of your account, you must update your registration data immediately. 

Click here: www.yourbnk-update.com 

Do not ignore this message! Failure to comply will result in permanent account suspension. 

Best Regards, 
YourBnk Support Team
generated_email.explicacao: This email contains multiple red flags that are common in phishing emails: 1. Misspelled words (Upddate, Costumer). 2. The email address of the sender (support@yourbnk.com) is suspicious and not the official email address of the bank. 3. The message creates a sense of urgency to pressure the recipient into taking action without thinking. 4. The link provided for updating the registration data is not an official bank link. Always check the email address of the sender and the URLs before clicking on any links.

Dear João Silva,

Our records indicate that it's time for your mandatory system password update. To maintain the security of your account, please update your password by clicking the link below:

[Update Password](http://www.update-password-yourcompany.com)

For security reasons, this link will expire in 48 hours. If you are unable to update your password within this timeframe, please contact the IT department directly at it-department@yourcompany.com.

generated_email.explicacao: This email appears to be from the company's IT department, asking the employee to update his system password. However, there are several suspicious indicators that this is a phishing email. First, the email address of the sender is not official but a spoofed version. Second, the link provided for updating the password leads to a suspicious website that does not match the official company website. Third, the email creates a sense of urgency by stating that the link will expire in 48 hours, which is a common tactic used in phishing attacks to rush the victim into taking action.
